name: gizza-ai/geojson-merge
summary: Combine multiple GeoJSON files or features into one FeatureCollection

tool.description: Combine multiple GeoJSON inputs into a single FeatureCollection. Inputs are provided concatenated (whitespace/newline separated, so line-delimited GeoJSON works): FeatureCollections contribute their features, bare Features pass through, and raw geometries are wrapped into Features — all flattened in input order. Options: indent (0 minifies), precision (round coordinates to N decimals; -1 keeps full precision), renumber (assign sequential integer ids), and source_property (tag each feature with its 1-based source-document number). Returns the merged GeoJSON. Runs locally.

geojson.description: One or more GeoJSON values to combine — FeatureCollections, bare Features, and raw geometries, concatenated (whitespace/newline separated, so line-delimited GeoJSON works too), e.g. '{"type":"Point","coordinates":[0,0]}\n{"type":"Point","coordinates":[1,1]}'. All features are flattened, in order, into one FeatureCollection.

indent.description: Output indentation in spaces (1-8). Use 0 to minify. Default 2.

precision.description: Round every coordinate to this many decimal places to shrink the output (0-15). Use -1 (default) to keep full precision.

renumber.description: Assign each output feature a fresh sequential integer id (0, 1, 2, …), overwriting existing ids. Fixes id collisions when merging sources. Default false.

source_property.description: If set to a property name, tag every feature with that property set to its 1-based source-document number, so merged features stay traceable to their origin. Blank (default) adds nothing.
